sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Technology remain the dominant market leaders, while defensive rotation picks up and Healthcare shows early signs of fading.

Energy continues to display commanding leadership at the top rank with near-perfect momentum, joined by Technology as the market's sustained performers. Defensive rotation is evident as Consumer Defensive achieves all-green status and improves its position, whereas cyclical and interest-sensitive groups like Consumer Cyclical and Real Estate remain deeply rooted among the weakest laggards. 

Meanwhile, short-term shifts are emerging under the surface. Communication Services and Consumer Defensive are gaining ground over the past five sessions, while Financials and Healthcare are slipping, with the latter flashing an early warning divergence as rank erosion meets otherwise solid momentum.

## Strength
- Only 2 of 11 sectors maintain all-green breadth across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD frames: Energy (momentum 0.97) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.62).
- Energy and Technology exhibit sustained leadership, both holding top-3 rank positions across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- Energy dominates the momentum leaderboard at 0.967 (YTD rank 1), followed by Technology at 0.800 (YTD rank 2).

## Movers & Momentum
- Consumer Defensive gained +1 spot over the last five sessions to reach rank 5 (momentum 0.62).
- Communication Services advanced +1 spot over five sessions to rank 7 (momentum 0.53).
- Financials dropped -1 spot over the five-day period, falling to rank 8 with a momentum score of 0.350.
- Real Estate (0.233), Consumer Cyclical (0.283), and Utilities (0.300) anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- Healthcare flashes an early-warning fading signal: despite high momentum of 0.600 (rank 6 YTD), its rank slipped -1 spot over the last five sessions.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and commodity-linked sectors maintain absolute market leadership, while defensive and consumer-staple pockets stage sharp short-term momentum rebounds against steep declines in Uranium and Aerospace & Defense.

Breadth remains concentrated, with 23 of 144 industry groups logging all-green performance across all tracked time horizons. Traditional energy dominates the top tiers, anchored by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 1.000, rank 1 YTD) and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.928, rank 8 YTD), alongside structural strength in Marine Shipping (0.902) and Copper (0.84). Conversely, rate-sensitive and industrial pockets like Mortgage Finance (0.013) and Airports & Air Services (0.061) sit at the absolute bottom of relative momentum.

A rapid rotation is underway underneath the surface. Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic jumped +33 spots over the last five sessions, accompanied by gains in consumer staples such as Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+16 spots) and Tobacco (+13 spots). Meanwhile, prior thematic leaders are suffering fast drawdowns, led by Uranium falling -24 spots to rank 120 and Aerospace & Defense sliding -21 spots to rank 93.

## Strength
- **Pervasive Energy Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holds the market's peak score (momentum 1.000, rank 1 YTD), supported by Oil & Gas Integrated (0.928, rank 8 YTD) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.868, rank 12 YTD) as all-green leaders.
- **Sustained Transport & Materials:** Marine Shipping (0.902 momentum) and Copper (0.84 momentum) remain locked into the top 36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Broad Tech & Health Pockets:** Electronics & Computer Distribution holds sustained leadership with a 0.852 momentum score (rank 3 YTD), alongside all-green runs in Diagnostics & Research (0.82) and Consumer Electronics (0.83).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Sharpest Short-Term Rebounds:** Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic paced 5-day gainers with a +33 rank jump to 83 (momentum 0.55), followed by Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+16 spots to rank 69) and Credit Services (+15 spots to rank 81).
- **Steepest Momentum Deteriorations:** Uranium collapsed -24 spots in 5 sessions to rank 120 (momentum 0.100), while Aerospace & Defense dropped -21 spots to rank 93 (momentum 0.330) and Silver gave up -17 spots to rank 43.
- **Persistent Macro Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.013 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Advertising Agencies (0.071 momentum, rank 144 YTD), and REIT - Mortgage (0.077 momentum, rank 138 YTD) remain anchored at multi-month troughs.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum Leaders:** Electronic Components (momentum 0.67) and Scientific & Technical Instruments (momentum 0.66) are showing distribution, sliding -5 and -6 rank spots respectively over 5 days despite elevated momentum profiles.
- **Healthcare & Durables Slipping:** Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.63, rank -5 in 5d) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.62, rank -4 in 5d) are exhibiting early rank decay.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Movers:** Grocery Stores (+9 rank improvement, momentum 0.46) and Consulting Services (+7 rank improvement, momentum 0.34) are advancing quickly from depressed momentum baselines, signaling early rotational inflows.
